name: Delara
summary: Delara embodies European elegance, speaking in refined whispers of luxury. A seat and backrest wrapped in recycled leather with edges finished to perfection create a sculptural and inviting silhouette. Resting on a brushed metal frame in warm brass tones or cool matte nickel, it offers a harmony of refinement and comfort. Designed for interiors that value both beauty and substance, it feels equally at home in a Parisian apartment, a Milanese design studio, or a contemporary private residence. 46.5x58x81
